Name: My Little Pony Horse
Author: Malenyaaa
Description:
Description
Your horse can be one of the six main ponies from My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic: Twilight Sparkle, Rarity, Rainbow Dash, Fluttershy, Pinkie Pie or Applejack.

Ride your horse or stand next to it and press P. Pick a pony, or go back to the normal horse. You can switch as often as you like, and every horse can be a different pony.

Work in progress: this mod isn't finished yet. Everything works, but there is still room to improve, especially the sprites. If you find a bug, or something looks off, please report it in the Bugs tab or the comments. And if you're a pixel artist and would like to make better pony sprites for it, I'd love to hear from you!

Installation instructions
1. Install SMAPI (https://smapi.io/).
2. Unzip the mod into your Mods folder.
3. Start the game through SMAPI.

Main features
- Six ponies: Twilight Sparkle, Rarity, Rainbow Dash, Fluttershy, Pinkie Pie and Applejack.
- Switch any time in-game: press P while riding your horse or standing next to it, then choose a pony or "Normal horse".
- Every horse can be a different pony. The choice is saved with the horse.
- Cute chibi pixel sprites with everything the horse does: walking in all four directions, grazing, swishing the tail and munching a carrot.
- When you ride towards the screen, the pony's face stays in front of you, and you sit on its back and bob along with its steps.
- Ponies don't wear hats. If your horse wore a hat, you get it back. Applejack brings her own.
- The key can be changed in config.json or with Generic Mod Config Menu (any SMAPI keybind, including controller buttons).
- Multiplayer: only the horse's owner can change it. Players without the mod see a normal horse.
- Removing the mod turns your ponies back into normal horses; nothing breaks.
- Horse retextures still work for horses you didn't turn into a pony. Tractor Mod's tractor is left alone.
- Translations: English, German.

Requirements
- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4.0+ (https://smapi.io/)
- Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu, to change the key in-game.
- In multiplayer, every player who wants to see the ponies needs the mod.

Shout outs
Huge thanks to ponett for the Pixel art inspo
Shoutout to fumaryako for the original My Little Pony horse mod from 2016.
My Little Pony is a trademark of Hasbro. This is a non-commercial fan mod.

AI disclosure: this mod was made with the help of an AI coding assistant (Claude by Anthropic). I came up with the idea, decided how it should look and behave, tested it in-game and reviewed the result. The AI wrote most of the code and adapted ponett's sprites to the horse layout. No AI image generator was used.

Source code (MIT): https://github.com/Malenyaaa/stardew-mods (the pony sprites are not part of the repository)
